title: East Maui water board community meetings
summary: The board planned a community meeting for April 2025 and in May 2026 discussed working with the parks department on timing for community meetings. A planned Upcountry and Kula community meeting was canceled after a tropical storm and is to be rescheduled for September or October.

timeline.text: A planned community meeting in Upcountry and Kula was canceled after a tropical storm.
Staff may work with the parks department on timing for the community meetings.
